resources.string: A keyboard of frosted glass: whatever app you type in shows through it, blurred. Hold a letter for accents and macrons, or a top-row letter for its number. Slide along the space bar to move the cursor, and hold it to change keyboards.
Very aggressive: always the best guess

Suggestions come from Android\'s own open-source keyboard engine and its English dictionary, and use where you touched each key. It learns the words you use and what you tend to type next, all on this phone. Each word is checked as you type the space (or punctuation) after it, and a fix goes in if it\'s confident enough for the strength above. Backspace straight after undoes it, and teaches it the word you meant.
Large: tall and wide, well above your thumb
From the app you\'re typing in (its main colour), or the system\'s if it has none
The blur is Android\'s window blur. Battery Saver turns it off, and the keyboard turns nearly solid until it\'s back.
